item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Seam 1.18.14
item.description:
Mac Notch Interactive Tool

Seam is a desktop productivity tool that brings a dynamic island-style interface to the Mac. It centralizes functions such as music control, schedule reminders, focus timers, and speech-to-text at the top of the screen, allowing users to quickly view information and perform operations during work, reducing interruptions from frequent application switching. The software supports playing pauses, switching tracks, viewing what is playing, selecting an audio output device within the player, or navigating to the browser tab that is playing. With built-in speech transcription and translation, all processing is done locally, no networking is required, no user data is collected, and voice, file, and schedule information never leaves your Mac. Users can enable features as needed and adjust details such as track display during pause, song title scrolling, and track skipping animations. In addition to the MacBook with the notch, Seam also adapts to displays and external screens connected to iMacs and Mac minis via a floating island mode. The software uses an event-triggered operation mode, maintaining low resource consumption when idle, making it suitable for Mac users who want to integrate frequently used tools, keep track of desktop status at any time, and value local privacy.

item.title: Sortroom 1.0
item.description:
macOS photo management software

Sortroom is a photo and video management software for macOS 26 and later. It directly reads existing folders on your Mac, portable SSD, and external hard drive, allowing you to browse common image formats, camera RAW files, videos, and Live Photos without importing them into your gallery. The software combines local photo recognition, intelligent categorization, and shooting time and location information to help organize years of accumulated materials. You can also create custom locations based on GPS range, allowing new and old photos to be automatically placed in the corresponding locations. Through statuses such as pending publication, planned publication, published publication, and pending editing, users can filter materials, arrange the carousel order, and record social media platforms, accounts, dates, and captions. The published log is for record-keeping only and does not automatically upload content. Batch renaming, folder archiving, and duplicate material cleanup all offer previews or manual confirmation, support undoing, and do not resave or compress photos. Tags can be carried with the hard drive or managed via a private iCloud sync. The software runs photo recognition on the device by default, requiring no account registration.

item.title: LuLu 4.5.6
item.description:
Open-source lightweight firewall for macOS

LuLu is a free, open-source macOS firewall that blocks unknown outgoing connections until you explicitly approve them. It detects and stops unauthorized network connections, helping prevent malware and third-party apps from sending data to remote servers. Its design is simple and easy to use, with a small attack surface, and its source code is public on GitHub for transparency. It supports single-user installs and currently focuses on process-level network rules. It provides basic network monitoring rather than full self-protection, so determined targeted attacks may still bypass it.

item.title: TypeWhisper 1.8.2
item.description:
macOS open-source Whisper speech-to-text tool

TypeWhisper is a native speech-to-text tool designed specifically for macOS, focusing on privacy and system-level integration. Users can dictate in any application simply by pressing a global hotkey; the text appears in real-time and is quickly inserted after speaking, with configurable behavior settings. TypeWhisper 1. The stable version 0 provides file transcription functionality, allowing users to drag and drop audio or video files for batch processing and export timestamped SRT or WebVTT subtitle files. It includes various built-in prompts for automated text transcription and supports deeper workflow integration via native API, CLI, and plugins. TypeWhisper emphasizes fully local operation, no telemetry, no subscriptions, no forced cloud dependencies, and voice data is always retained on user devices. The software supports app-aware profiles that automatically switch language, engine, and behavior settings depending on the app or website. History allows all transcriptions to be searched, dictionaries provide correction rules for improved accuracy, and snippets make it easy to store and reuse commonly used text.

item.title: Stats 3.0.24
item.description:
System monitor for the menu bar

Stats is a system monitoring tool that lives in the macOS menu bar and shows live metrics: battery level, Bluetooth device connections, CPU frequency (Intel only), CPU usage, disk usage, fan speed, GPU usage, memory, network usage, and temperature, voltage and power from various sensors. It supports many interface languages, several menu bar styles (bar chart, pie chart, line graph, numbers), customizable metrics, and alerts that play a sound or send a notification when a threshold is reached.

item.title: Switch 0.3.20
item.description:
Window-level ⌘Tab switcher for macOS

Switch is a window switcher for macOS that changes the usual ⌘-Tab behavior from app-level to window-level cycling. Use ⌘-Tab to go forward, ⇧⌘Tab to go back, and ⌥-` to cycle windows within an app, including across multiple Spaces. Windows appear in a vertical list you can filter by typing. A Sticky mode lets you preview a window without committing to the switch, and shortcuts let you close a window (⌘W), quit an app (⌘Q) or hide it (⌘H). It is free, open source, notarized, and requires macOS 14 or later.

item.title: macshot 4.4.0
item.description:
macOS native screenshot tool

MacShot is a native screenshot and screen recording tool for macOS. It offers features such as region screenshots, window captures, full-screen screenshots, and cross-monitor stitching. It also supports quick annotation of content using tools such as arrows, rectangles, ellipses, text, pencils, highlighters, number markers, stamps, and emojis. The software includes built-in pixelation, blurring, solid color masking, and smart erasing functions. It can automatically recognize faces, people, and sensitive information such as email addresses, phone numbers, and API keys. Scrolling screenshots can generate long images using Apple Vision, and OCR can recognize multiple languages ​​and copy, translate, or search text. MacShot also supports recording MP4 and GIFs at up to 120fps, capturing system audio, microphone input, and mouse highlights, and provides editing capabilities. After taking a screenshot, you can add gradient backgrounds, window borders, shadows, padding, and rounded corners. You can also upload it to Google Drive, imgbb, or other S3-compatible services with one click. The software is developed using Swift and AppKit, has no Electron or web view, is always present in the menu bar, supports 40 languages, and features configurable keyboard shortcuts, history, and undo/redo functionality.

item.title: Open Island 1.3.2
item.description:
Lingdong Island AI Programming Vibe Agent Manager

Open Island is an open-source native AI programming agent control center for macOS developers. It can reside in the notch area or at the top of the screen, presenting agent session status, task progress, permission requests, and usage in real time with a compact interface, and supports one-click return to the corresponding terminal tab, split-screen pane, IDE workspace, or Codex desktop dialog. The software is built using SwiftUI and AppKit, prioritizing local availability and not relying on servers, accounts, or telemetry services. It automatically discovers sessions from local records and restores them after a restart. It can connect to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Kimi CLI, OpenCode, Qoder, Qwen Code, Factory, and CodeBuddy, and is also compatible with various development environments such as Terminal, Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm, tmux, Zellij, VS Code, and JetBrains.

item.title: Nimble Commander 1.9.0
item.description:
macOS 2-column file manager

Nimble Commander is a two-column file manager for macOS. It adopts a classic, orthodox file manager approach and is optimized for developers, system administrators, IT professionals, and advanced Mac users. With keyboard operation at its core, it offers hundreds of shortcuts, allowing for quick and easy copying, moving, selecting, filtering, searching, renaming, and directory navigation. The program is mainly written in C + +, emphasizing low resource occupation and immediate response, even if multiple windows and tabs are opened at the same time. The software has built-in file search, text and hex viewer, batch renaming, terminal emulator, zip package browsing, FTP/SFTP/WebDAV connection, system information viewing, file properties and label editing, link processing and administrator mode. The interface is highly customizable, including colors, fonts, sizes, display methods, hotkey layouts, quick search behavior, and external tool configurations. It retains the classic monospace font style while also catering to the modern macOS integration experience.

item.title: Backdrop 2.10.5
item.description:
Powerful 4K live wallpaper engine for macOS

Backdrop is a live wallpaper and video desktop tool for macOS that turns your desktop and lock screen into smooth visual scenes. It supports 4K video wallpapers, browsing community creations, importing your own videos, multi-display playback and playlists. You can filter community wallpapers by style, color, mood, resolution or creator, or quickly make your own background from a video. It is optimized for Mac with hardware acceleration, plays smoothly on Retina and multi-screen setups, and lowers resource use when apps are full screen or the Mac is on battery. Its lock screen video wallpaper support keeps the desktop and lock screen visually consistent.

item.title: DockFlow 1.91
item.description:
Mac Dock Grouping Layout Tool

DockFlow is a workspace switching tool designed specifically for Mac users. It aims to help users quickly create and switch between different dock icon combinations to suit various work scenarios. Users simply set the desired application and folder icons and can easily switch to a custom dock layout via keyboard shortcuts or menu bar icons, improving work efficiency. DockFlow supports adding a variety of items, including folders, files, and URL links, to facilitate one-click access to commonly used resources. DockFlow allows users to set icon intervals, reasonably layout icons, and supports exporting and importing personalized configurations for easy system migration or sharing. With DockFlow, users can quickly adapt to different workflows, eliminating the distractions of context switching and allowing them to focus more on their work. DockFlow is a program dock switching tool designed for macOS users to simplify workspace management and help users quickly create and switch between different combinations of Dock icons to suit different work scenarios. With a one-time setup, DockFlow offers lifelong productivity gains.

item.title: VMPal Virtual Machines 0.113
item.description:
Lightweight multi-system virtual machine for macOS

VMPal is Apple silicon Mac virtual machine software built by the TablePlus team for macOS 26 and later that runs macOS, Windows 11, and multiple Linux distributions on the same Mac. The software uses Apple's virtualization framework for macOS and Linux, provides a self-developed engine for Windows, and provides Metal, Direct3D 11, or OpenGL 4.1 graphics acceleration for different systems, supporting Retina displays up to 5K. Users can choose to automatically download and install the system version, or create a virtual machine using an existing IPSW or ISO file. Daily operations support bidirectional clipboard, drag-and-drop file transfer, shared folders, port forwarding, and adjustments to disk and network settings during runtime. Virtual disks, clones, and snapshots use space-saving storage methods, making migration, copying, and quick rollback easy. Each virtual machine also has an independent Dock icon and audio permission control.

item.title: Invoke 1.1.1
item.description:
macOS Radial Menu Launcher

Invoke is a radial menu launcher for macOS that allows designers, developers, and content creators to focus common actions near the mouse cursor. By simply pressing or long pressing the custom shortcut key, the user can call up a fan menu that can be quickly selected, or by clicking and opening the menu, or pressing and holding the shortcut key to complete the selection and release, directly executing the corresponding action, reducing the time to memorize a large number of shortcuts and repeatedly searching for the menu bar. The software can automatically switch the menu content according to the currently used application, providing a dedicated operation portal for different work scenarios. Menu items support hotkeys, apps, folders, URLs, text snippets, and Apple shortcuts, and can be personalized with emojis, SF Symbols, and a variety of icon libraries. Invoke also integrates clipboard history, color picker, music controls, and focus timers to support search, tag classification, hex and RGB color formats, playback controls, and custom focus and rest reminders. Users can create submenus, import popular app presets, and choose to sync clipboard history across multiple Macs via iCloud.

item.title: MusicHarbor 5.4.0
item.description:
Automatically tracks music albums and singles

MusicHarbor is a music distribution tracking app for music lovers on macOS that gives you instant access to your favorite artists' albums, singles, EPs, music videos, news, and concerts. Users can quickly import followers from Apple Music, Last.fm, or local music libraries. All data is saved on local devices. Through iCloud, users can seamlessly sync between iPhone, iPad, and Mac without registering an account. The app presents new releases by timeline, supports filtering by album, single, EP, remix, live recording, acoustic, and more, previews upcoming albums, and automatically adds release dates to the calendar. Users can browse the various types of music charts in various countries to discover new artists, while reviewing previous releases to celebrate the anniversary of the album. The Music Videos section tracks newly released official music videos, lyrics videos, interviews, and live performances in real time, and browses the top music video charts by country and genre.

item.title: CrewTower 1.0.38
item.description:
Lingdong Island AI Agent Request Approval

CrewTower is a native AI agent session management tool for macOS users that centralizes tasks from desktop applications, editors, and terminals such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, and opencode into a floating capsule at the top of the Mac or on other displays. Users can view task progress, context usage, running status, completion reminders, and requests that need to be processed without frequently switching windows. They can also directly approve or reject supported commands, answer questions, select solutions, review plans, and submit feedback. For dangerous operations, CrewTower displays clear warnings and provides options such as one-time, current session, or always allow. Jump takes the user back to an accurate app window, tab, terminal window, panel, or tmux pane.

item.title: extraDock 5.2.4-beta.4
item.description:
macOS Create Multiple Dock Tools

ExtraDock is a lightweight app designed for macOS users that improves productivity by creating multiple floating docks. It supports macOS 12 and above, and users can customize multiple docks as needed, each of which can set up separate apps, folders, layouts, and behaviors. The software allows the Dock to float freely or be fixed to the edge of the screen, and also supports automatic hiding or storing as needed, saving screen space. ExtraDock also has a full-screen app-aware feature that automatically hides in full-screen mode and recovers location when connected. At the same time, it offers multiple color themes and adjustable dock sizes, allowing users to make arbitrary layouts based on their individual workflows. Users can easily add apps and folders by dragging and dropping. ExtraDock's performance is optimized to ensure low CPU and memory usage and provide a smooth animation experience. ExtraDock is a lightweight application that allows you to create multiple floating Docks on macOS.

item.title: Notchy 2.0.3
item.description:
macOS bangs augmentation tool

Notchy is a native macOS agile island and efficiency tool that turns the bangs area of the screen into an interactive control center that can run as a suspended capsule on Macs and external monitors without bangs. The software integrates music playback, synchronized lyrics, clipboard history, file staging, pomodoro timing, window snapping, and system status prompts to focus common actions at the top of the screen, reducing the number of switching windows and lookup menus. For development scenarios, it can track the usage, quota window and expenses of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other tools, and display the execution status of agent activities, permission requests and long-time commands. Face unlocking is achieved through camera, Apple Vision local recognition and live detection. Facial features and passwords are saved in the macOS keychain, which is a convenient unlocking function, not equivalent to the infrared depth recognition of Apple Face ID. Notchy also provides app-independent volume, AirPods battery, OCR image text search, meeting suggestions, calendar reminders, and shortcut entries to support custom panels, gestures, and multiple real-time events displayed side-by-side.

item.title: NotchPad 1.9.4
item.description:
Liuhai Area Quick Note Tool

NotchPad is a Mac Security Notepad app designed for MacBook Liu Haiping that cleverly integrates notepads, clipboard history, and reusable snippets into the MacBook's Liuhai area, providing quick access with just a mouse hover without switching windows or interrupting current workflows. NotchPad supports rich text editing features, including bold, italics, lists, and other formats, so users can easily pin important notes to the top and quickly find what they need with an instant search. The app enables encryption protection by default, and all data is stored locally on your Mac and never sent to any server for privacy. NotchPad syncs with Apple Notes in both directions. Users can browse and edit Apple Notes in-app, and the changes are instantly returned to the native Notes app. It also supports more than 50 file types, including txt, Markdown, RTF, Word, PDF, and various code files such as Swift, Python, JavaScript, etc. After importing, it will retain a rich text format.

item.title: iA Presenter 2.1.2
item.description:
macOS presentation creation software

iA Presenter is a text-driven presentation authoring tool for macOS that integrates writing, presentation, slide design, and live presentation in a single process, allowing users to first focus on organizing stories and perspectives, and then the software automatically generates a clear and beautiful page layout. You can paste your existing content directly, split paragraphs, set titles, insert images or videos like you write articles, and the software will automatically process the layout, color, scale, and visual rhythm based on the content. Plain text can be used as a presentation that is only visible to you, with the title and focus displayed on the slide to help the speaker distinguish between “what to say” and “what to show.” It provides speaker views, rhetorical prompts, template customization, responsive screen adaptation, and post-demonstration export as readable handouts for teachers, speakers, designers, researchers, and those who need to prepare their presentations quickly.

item.title: Floodtide 1.5.0
item.description:
App updater for macOS

Floodtide is an app updater for macOS that reads the latest version information from each app's own Sparkle update feed and from the Homebrew catalog, then scans supported apps and updates them in bulk. It needs no hand-maintained app database and no Homebrew installation, and it checks official downloads and checksums published by developers. Apps whose update source can't be verified are listed clearly rather than guessed at. It offers one-click Update All, automatic backup before updating, undo of recent updates within seven days, and checks of code signature, Gatekeeper results and developer team before installing. It supports macOS 13 or later on Intel and Apple Silicon, keeps its app list on your Mac, and needs no account or special permissions.

item.title: Tuck Pro 1.4.7
item.description:
Hide menu bar icons on Mac

Tuck is a native menu bar organizer for macOS 14 to 27 that tidies up the growing pile of app and system icons. In Push mode, one click hides the menu bar icons to the left of Tuck and another click restores them; on notched MacBooks, hidden items appear in a Shelf panel below the menu bar. You can drag icons to reorder them, set each to always show, always hide or follow the main toggle, and control it with shortcuts. Pro adds auto-hide, show-on-hover, per-app visibility rules and Shelf customization. It is under 10 MB with no telemetry; the free version has no time limit and Pro is a one-time license for up to three Macs.

item.title: Tokens 4 Breakfast 2.0.19
item.description:
Menu bar Token usage monitoring

Tokens 4 Breakfast is a macOS menu bar application for developers and heavy users of AI tools. It is used to track the token usage, API consumption, subscription items, and rate limiting pressures of platforms such as Claude Code, Claude Web, OpenAI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, DeepSeek, Mistral, and OpenRouter. It aggregates AI spending scattered across web pages, dashboards, and billing pages into a permanent menu bar view that shows, in real time, current month spending, seven-day trends, thirty-day forecasts, session budgets, and upcoming quota risks. The application adopts the local priority design, does not need to log in to the account, does not rely on cloud services, does not track, the data is saved in the Mac native SQLite database, and can work offline; Claude Code automatically connects with GitHub Copilot to read local configuration or session files, and other platforms access via API Key.

item.title: HapiGo 2.23.1
item.description:
macOS Efficiency Launcher

HapiGo is an efficient launcher designed for brain workers, replacing manual opening of apps and files, making every launch more productive and helping users move from excellence to excellence. HapiGo redefines the launcher experience with instant searches, quick previews, and direct launches, allowing users to quickly find the target file or app without the need for full input, and search much faster than Spotlight. It also offers convenient features such as quick previews of documents, a bottom action bar to simplify common actions, docking with well-known apps such as Apple Notes, clipboard management, translation integration, and a wide selection of personalized themes. HapiGo supports shortcuts, system commands, drag and drop operations, and full keyboard operations, which greatly improves user flexibility and convenience. With HapiGo, users can more efficiently aggregate dispersed information and open up new experiences for productive work. Instant search: HapiGo uses a redeveloped local search engine to support instant search. Users can find the target file or application without completing the input. The retrieval time is about 10ms, which is significantly faster than Spotlight's 50ms.

item.title: Paperman 3.15.0
item.description:
Mac screen paper texture eye-protection reading tool

Paperman is a screen visual softening tool for macOS that scatters glaring highlights and eases intense contrast by overlaying delicate paper textures on display content, bringing the screen closer to a readable physical surface without actively changing its original color, making it suitable for long periods of reading, writing, programming, and daily office work. The software offers seven styles of classic matte, light-weave, sun-solar parchment, saddle linen, cold-press paper, mulberry tulle and hazy sulphur paper, each texture independently adjusts intensity and memorizes light and dark mode settings respectively. The experimental table lamp mode creates a warm light zone above the texture, allowing you to adjust the direction of incoming light, color temperature, height, diffusion range and edge dimming, or apply a variety of lighting presets directly. Users can pin four common textures, quickly switch through the Control Center or global shortcuts, and specify different effects and automatic scheduling for day and night. Application exceptions support exclusion mode and only allow mode, which can deactivate the overlay for programs that value color accuracy, such as retouching; At the same time, it has the ability of timing naps, battery suspension, camera bangs area protection, screenshot and screen recording concealment, multi-monitor management, sleep wake-up recovery and external screen reconnection.

item.title: SmashTunes 5.13.1
item.description:
Music Controller in Menu Bar

SmashTunes for Music & Spotify is a menu bar music control tool for macOS that manages Apple Music, Spotify, and extends to Volumio scenes in the new version. It continuously displays the information of the song being played in the menu bar, including the song title, artist, album, playback time and countdown, and can display the album cover, so that users can grasp the playback status without frequently switching back to the music app. The software supports global shortcuts to control playback, skip, rate, like, volume, add tracks, and more. You can also select playlists, add songs to your library, or assign song lists directly from the menu bar. SmashTunes for Music & Spotify also automatically coordinates playback status between Music and Spotify, preventing two apps from making noise at the same time, and supports collection synchronization, rating linkage, Spotify playlist authorization, ListenBrainz scrobbling, and the new version of macOS compatibility fix, which is suitable for heavy music users to centralize common controls to the top of the desktop.

item.title: CamLoop 1.2.14
item.description:
macOS Virtual Camera

CamLoop is a macOS menu bar virtual camera tool that loops pre-recorded personal clips into video conferencing, allowing users to leave their seats briefly while still viewing the camera. The software is compatible with applications such as Zoom, Google Meet, Slack, Microsoft Teams, FaceTime, and OBS that support camera selection. After selecting CamLoop in the meeting, you can switch between loop clips and real-time screens through the menu. The Pro version also supports custom global shortcuts. The first frame fragment at the time of recording helps to align the pose. When returning to the live broadcast, it will wait for a clear and normally exposed picture to switch, reducing dark frames and sudden jumping. The loop includes forward and backward playback, as well as the Pro version's analog network latency and local AI complementary frame connection; the Pro version also provides real-time freezing, catoning, low bitrate effects, unlimited fragment management, and virtual camera renaming. The video is saved locally on the Mac, not uploaded to the cloud, the software does not record or take over the audio, and voice communication in the meeting can continue.

item.title: MistBar 1.1.0
item.description:
macOS menu bar organization

MistBar is a menu bar organizing tool for Apple silicon and macOS 26 and above. It focuses on integrating infrequently clicked status bar icons into a unified portal to keep frequently used items visible. Hidden items can be quickly recalled by hovering, clicking or shortcuts. It is not only used to clean up the menu bar, but also has built-in clipboard history and common fragments, mail aggregation, quick search, app launcher, folder access, Apple Notes quick record, text extension, and AI tool usage viewing functions such as Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, etc. The software uses macOS accessibility to organize icons without relying on screen recording, so it does not capture screen content and does not trigger purple recording prompts; The data is mainly processed by the machine, no account, analysis or tracking is required, which is suitable for Mac users who want a clearer menu bar and want to keep the entrance of high-frequency tools.

item.title: Sidekick 1.5.29
item.description:
macOS Natural Language AI Automation

Sidekick is an AI agent built for macOS that performs tasks across apps, files, and systems with natural language instructions for macOS 15 and up, and is compatible with Apple chips and Intel Macs. Users can click on the desktop hover bubble, or press Option and Spacebar to invoke the input interface to organize the desktop, rename files by content, find recently edited documents, fill out forms, schedule Teams meetings, and close and group browser tabs. It also supports video downloading, audio-visual and picture conversion, PDF merging and splitting, system hardware information query and Spotlight indexing fault repair, and can read documents on the screen, refine contract summaries and terms that need to be reviewed. The cleanup feature looks for caches, duplicate photos, and old install packages, which are confirmed by the user before deletion. When the task is completed, the results of the execution will be displayed and the revocation entrance will be provided for the applicable operation; Sensitive operations need to be reviewed first, and the safety input fields are not within the scope of operations. At present, the Enterprise Edition is in the early preview stage, providing centralized management capabilities such as AI usage analysis, subscription and call cost optimization, duplicate work identification, and equipment operation and maintenance.

item.title: DockGroups 1.13.0
item.description:
macOS Dock App Grouping Tool

DockGroups is a Dock application organization and workflow launch tool for macOS users. It can create application groups by project, task or use scenario, and classify common software such as VS Code, Terminal, Chrome, Slack, Figma, Notion into development, design, conference, and focus work modes. Users can quickly restore the cleanliness of the desktop by opening all the applications in a group with one click through the dock, menu bar or keyboard shortcuts, and batch exiting or hiding the relevant programs after work. The software provides independent instance mode, which can create lightweight windows and exclusive Dock icons for each group for long-term use; dynamic Most Used groups are automatically sorted according to the number of application launches, without manual maintenance. DockGroups runs natively on SwiftUI, does not replace the system Dock, and does not require additional system permissions. The data is always stored natively, and is compatible with Apple Silicon and Intel processors. It supports macOS 14 Sonoma, macOS 15 Sequoia, and macOS 26 Tahoe.

item.title: Marked 3.2.27
item.description:
Professional Markdown preview tool for macOS

Marked 3 is a Markdown preview and proofreading tool for Mac, built around live rendering, attractive themes and strong export options, aimed at writers, developers, editors and technical documentation work. It works alongside your usual text editor to show the final result as you write, and adds grammar checking, style hints, repeated-word highlighting, document statistics and table of contents generation. It includes many themes, custom CSS and style management, exports to PDF, HTML, DOCX and EPUB, and works with Scrivener, MarsEdit, Ulysses, Obsidian-style calls and many Markdown processors, covering writing, review and publishing.

item.title: ShowRunner 2.9.2
item.description:
Mac Automated Demo Recording

ShowRunner is a macOS automated presentation recording tool for creating software tutorials, product feature demonstrations, App Store materials, social media videos, and support documentation. Users can program their operation flow from actions such as moving, clicking, right-clicking, dragging and dropping, typing, using shortcuts, scrolling, waiting, and switching applications. They can also directly record their own operations, and the software will stably reproduce real mouse and keyboard behavior, ensuring that each demonstration maintains a consistent rhythm and focus. The real-time run mode drives the actual macOS cursor and provides controls such as Esc emergency stop, floating step list, starting a specified step, and hiding irrelevant applications; the run and record mode executes the process and captures the screen simultaneously. The built-in editor supports frame-by-frame timelines, cuts, fades, auto-zooms, manual zooms, picture-in-picture, hotspot accents, scene backgrounds, and transitions, and adjusts the movement curves, tilt, stretch, motion blur, trailing, click bounce, and color click rings of the composite cursor. A single project can accommodate multiple independent scenes and render the cursor, zoom, camera, and background in a unified MP4 format at the native capture resolution. It can also export each scene separately.

item.title: MoveMatic 3.3
item.description:
Native Mac product animation tools

MoveMatic is a native dynamic design tool for macOS, built for product demos, App Store preview videos, social media marketing clips, and presentation animations. It supports setting the canvas to the Apple preview size, adds dynamic elements such as animated cursors, click hotspots, lens scaling, callout arrows, particle effects, pulses, and pathfollowing to the app interface, and can export MP4 videos. The software uses the visibility time span as the core unit of layer animation, and each layer can set independent entry and exit effects, which is convenient for quickly arranging the rhythm of the appearance and disappearance of elements. Timeline supports ripple editing, which automatically adjusts when you move a keyframe, span edge, sublayer, or video clip. MoveMatic also offers programmatic behavior without frame-by-frame settings, scene sequences, scene transitions, global audio, lens zoom layers, auto-drawing arrows, arbitrary layer particles, and batch mix-and-arrange features, as well as clip sheets with film thumbnails and precise entry and exit controls for fast production of crisp, sophisticated, and product-expressive Mac video content.
